data.one_liner: A circular color picker widget that picks HSL colors in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a circular color picker widget for Flutter applications. Allows users to select colors using a draggable thumb on a circular track and supports dynamic color control via a controller.
use_when: You need a circular color picker widget in your UI.
You want users to select HSL colors visually.
avoid_when: You need standard form pickers like date or file pickers.
You prefer grid-based or palette-style color pickers.
strengths: Provides a controller to manage picker color dynamically.
Includes customizable size, stroke width, and thumb size.
weaknesses: Limited to a circular UI format.

alternatives.name: flutter_colorpicker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative color picker package with different UI styles.

alternatives.name: flex_color_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Another comprehensive color picker option for Flutter.

data.minimal_example:
CircleColorPicker(
  initialColor: Colors.blue,
  onChanged: (color) => print(color),
  size: const Size(240, 240),
  strokeWidth: 4,
  thumbSize: 36,
)
